# ForgeRepo Copilot Instructions

Read and follow:

- `CLAUDE.md` — canonical repository AI instructions
- `docs/README.md` — documentation index
- `docs/architecture/overview.md` — architecture overview
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — workflow

Do not invent architecture rules that are not documented.

When a code change materially changes architecture, configuration semantics, or project graph behavior, update the relevant document under `docs/` and create/update an ADR when appropriate.
